name: smwmusic-robowarrior-bomber-king-cutting-edge-explosion-stage
title: RoboWarrior / Bomber King - Cutting Edge Explosion 💥 ~ Stage 1 (Cut-mix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Bomber King Theme from RoboWarrior / Bomber King
ft. Cut Man's Stage from Mega Man Numero Uno
. Wanted to spend time on an obscure game this time around, and I remember the Bomber King theme existed all of the sudden, so I decided to cook that one up.

I remember first hearing it in Mushroom Kingdom Meltdown years ago, and played Blaster Master Boy for the first time a couple months back. Little did I know that Blaster Master Boy was actually a sequel to another series that got changed by SUNSOFT (because Blaster Master do be like that, ya know), and the first stage theme was from RoboWarrior. Honestly, makes sense to make it a Blaster Master title. The NES game had banger tunes, and this one also did too.
